placementGuidelines: Non-stop tropical bloomer that is a genuinely thirsty heavy feeder - unlike most of the pollinator lineup in this guide, it wants its container root-bound and consistently damp rather than dry between waterings. Best in a snug 1-2 gal. plastic pot (plastic's moisture retention suits it better than terracotta or fabric grow bags, which dry out too fast for this species). A too-large pot holds stagnant water around the roots and causes rot even though the plant itself wants steady moisture - size the pot to the plant, not the other way around. Feed every 2 weeks with a phosphorus-heavy bloom booster during active growth. In a soil mix built for fabric grow bags, favor peat moss over perlite to hold moisture (skip vermiculite unless budget allows - peat alone covers most of the water-retention need). Not reliably cold-hardy outside zone 9b+; treat as a container annual or overwinter indoors.
